title: Kevin W. Pearson
vital_facts: Baptized as a child, Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Bachelor's degree in Finance from University of Utah, 1981; MBA from Harvard Business School, 1983.
Married June Langeland, 1980, Salt Lake Temple. Parents of six children.

Vice president, Brighton Consulting Group, 1984-1988; Principal, Ernst & Young, 1988-1991; Chief Operating Officer/Chief Financial Officer, Medicode, 1991-1997; Chief Executive Officer, Ingenix, Inc., 1998-2005.
Elders Quorum President, Young Men President, Bishop's Counselor and Bishop.
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
